AcceptanceEvidence.description: Graph-bound diagnostic payload, not a safety or acoustic acceptance certificate.

binding.description: Independent digest covering both the view payload and delivered graph ID.

payload.description: Serialized quality bundles and explicit unavailable reasons by channel.

version.description: Version controlling interpretation of the quality-owned payload.

correction_band_hz.description:
Explicit active-correction support, when a policy was selected.
`evaluated_band_hz` remains the fixed observation band.

max_boost_db.description:
Acoustic response-ratio improvement in dB (post minus pre level).

This is measured level change at the seat, not filter gain: coherent
summation across branches can move it without any filter boosting.
The enforced backstop compares this against the runtime policy; see
`max_electrical_boost_db` for the filter-side upper bound.

max_electrical_boost_db.description:
Upper bound on electrical filter boost in dB, when evaluable.

Sums positive IIR-element gains (EQ bands, shelves, gain trims, route
gains) per branch; cascade overlap inflates it above the realized
peak. Branches with convolution content are excluded (sidecar taps
are unevaluated), and the field is absent when no branch is fully
evaluable. Advisory: enforcement stays on the acoustic backstop
until matrix evidence justifies switching the checked quantity.

measurement_overlap_hz.description:
Common measured band, absent when independently assessed inputs have
disjoint support. Each final-seat record retains its assessed band.

useful_output.description:
Unnormalized output evidence; absent in legacy scorecards, never inferred
from level-independent shape metrics.

AngularCoverage.description:
Off-axis/angular coverage of a direct-sound capture.

Detail correction above the modal transition needs angular evidence;
a single on-axis capture never authorizes high-resolution speaker
inversion. Angles are loudspeaker-relative azimuth in degrees.

angles_deg.description: Measured off-axis angles in degrees (on-axis `0.0` may be included).

AppliedThreshold.description: One threshold applied during an assessment, with units.

unit.description:
Unit string, e.g. `"db"`, `"erb"`, `"sones-experimental-proxy"`.
Proxy units are labeled experimental; they are not portable
audibility thresholds.

AreaPriorKind.description: Probability density shape over positions, JSON-serialisable.

Axis-aligned Gaussian density. `mean` and `cov_diag` must each have
length equal to the number of dimensions; truncated at ±k·σ.

oneOf.description: Sobol low-discrepancy QMC with `num_points` samples.

oneOf.description: Latin-Hypercube sampling.
Gauss–Legendre tensor product. Total points = `points_per_axis^D`.

oneOf.description: Probability-weighted mean (expected loss over the listening area).
Worst-case (max) over the area's bounding box. Inner DE search.
CVaR at level α — mean of the worst α-fraction of points.

AssessmentConfidence.description:
How much the available evidence supports an assessment.

`Unknown` is the default: missing data is reported as unknown, never
as confidence.

oneOf.description: Independent or held-out evidence supports the outcome.
Consistent evidence within the calibration set only.
Weak, contradictory, or single-source evidence.
No assessment ran, or inputs were missing. The default.

AssessmentProvenance.description:
Model, calibration, and reference behind one assessment.

Every applied or proposed change reports these four so a reader can
reproduce the comparison. Sentinel defaults (`"unspecified"` /
`"unknown"`) are honest placeholders, not claims.

calibration.description:
Calibration or level assumption, e.g. `"nominal-75phon"` or
`"unknown-spl"`. A nominal loudness-level setting is not an SPL
calibration.

model_version.description: Model or code version the assessment ran under.

reference.description:
Comparison reference identity: the frozen full-chain id for pruning
comparisons, or the declared desired reference for quality
comparisons.

AssessmentRecord.description:
One assessment report: outcome, confidence, enforcement, and provenance.

The default is an unassessed record (`InsufficientEvidence` /
`Unknown` / `Advisory`), never a passing one.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason summary. `"unstated"` when not recorded.

thresholds.description: Thresholds applied, with units. Empty when none were applied.

AsymmetricLossConfig.description:
Configuration for asymmetric loss weighting.

Weights apply per sample as a multiplier on the squared error. The
peak / dip split uses a sigmoid crossfade in log frequency around
`transition_freq` so the transition from bass weighting to mid/treble
weighting is smooth. Narrow-null suppression is a separate mask passed
to the loss function at call time (see
[`crate::roomeq::impulse_analysis::build_null_suppression_mask`]).

bass_dip_weight.description:
Weight for bass dips (below `transition_freq`). Default: 1.0

Historically this defaulted to 0.2 (near-ignore) as a crude
proxy for "do not fight acoustic nulls". With explicit narrow-null
suppression in place, broad bass dips (SBIR, baffle step) become
legitimate correction targets and the dip weight is aligned with
the mid/treble default.

dip_weight.description: Weight for negative errors (dips above `transition_freq`). Default: 1.0

peak_weight.description: Weight for positive errors (peaks above `transition_freq`). Default: 2.0

transition_freq.description: Transition frequency between bass and mid/treble weighting. Default: 300.0 Hz

AudibilityDeadbandConfig.description:
Heuristic residual deadband applied after perceptual or octave smoothing.

The band thresholds are optimizer tuning values, not literal
psychoacoustic JND estimates.

disable_below_schroeder.description: Do not apply the deadband below the resolved Schroeder/modal region.

schroeder_hz.description: Schroeder fallback used when no measured value is available.

AutoOptimizerConfig.description: Opt-in automatic room EQ optimizer bound selection.

enabled.description: Enable automatic selection for the fields below.

filter_count.description: Automatically choose the maximum PEQ filter count.

gain_bounds.description: Automatically choose gain bounds and boost envelopes.

max_filters.description: Maximum filter count when automatic count selection is enabled.

min_filters.description: Minimum filter count when automatic count selection is enabled.

AveragingMethod.description:
How the capture was averaged across space or time.

A moving-microphone average cannot supply a physical phase response
or room impulse response, so it is never a phase source.

oneOf.description: Stationary microphone; timing reference preserved.
Moving-microphone magnitude average; magnitude only.
Averaging method was not recorded.

BandImprovement.description: Raw improvement split into modal bass, crossover overlap, and upper band.

bass_band_hz.description: Modal-bass band actually evaluated, in Hz.

bass_improvement_db.description: Raw improvement over the bass band; absent with fewer than two bins.

crossover_band_hz.description:
Crossover-overlap band (XO ± one octave, clamped); absent when the
input has no routed crossover frequency.

crossover_improvement_db.description: Raw improvement over the crossover band; absent when unassessed.

schroeder_hz.description: Schroeder frequency splitting bass from upper, in Hz.

upper_band_hz.description: Remaining usable upper band actually evaluated, in Hz.

upper_improvement_db.description: Raw improvement over the upper band; absent with fewer than two bins.

bass_anchor_coherence.description:
Magnitude-squared coherence γ² ∈ [0, 1] between the mic and the
loopback per-window phasors at `bass_freq_hz`. Conventional QA
threshold is γ² > 0.9. `None` when no loopback channel was
recorded.

bass_anchor_loopback_phase_deg.description:
Raw loopback reference phase in degrees (sin-referenced).
`None` when no loopback channel was recorded.

bass_anchor_magnitude.description:
Linear magnitude of the lock-in I/Q estimator at
`bass_freq_hz` on the mic. SNR proxy.

bass_anchor_phase_deg.description:
Reported phase of the bass tone at the listening position,
degrees in `(−180°, 180°]`, sin-referenced. When a loopback
reference channel was recorded this is the loopback-corrected
acoustic phase (`phase_mic − phase_loopback`); see
`bass_anchor_loopback_phase_deg` for the raw loopback value.

bass_anchor_stability_deg.description:
Circular standard deviation of phase across the sub-window
lock-in estimates, in degrees. Values above the
`"bass_anchor_unreliable"` advisory threshold (§2.8, 20°) mean
the GD confidence gate should discard this channel's anchor.

channel_index.description: Channel output index used during playback.

BassAnchorResultsLegacy.description:
Serializable mirror of the engine's `BassAnchorResults`. Captures
the per-channel phase at the bass anchor frequency so that GD-Opt
v2's confidence gate (§3.5 of `docs/gd_opt_v2_plan.md`) and
optimiser (§3.2) can ingest it at config-load time without
depending on `sotf-engine`.

Implements a custom `Deserialize` that also accepts the pre-v2
schema field name `bass_cycles: u16`; when present (and
`bass_duration_s` is absent) it is converted to seconds via
`cycles / bass_freq_hz` so older recordings.json files load without
re-recording.

bass_duration_s.description: Total tone length in seconds (steady portion + fades). Nominal 2.0.

bass_freq_hz.description: Centre frequency of the steady-state tone in Hz (nominal 30 Hz).

sample_rate.description: Sample rate used for the capture (Hz).

BassManagementConfig.description:
Home-cinema bass-management policy.

This describes how RoomEQ should reason about the main high-pass, sub
low-pass, redirected bass, and the LFE programme path. The current DSP
exporter still emits per-output-channel correction chains, so LFE +10 dB
is reported but not inserted by default: applying it to the physical sub
chain would also boost redirected bass.

apply_lfe_gain_to_chain.description:
Explicitly insert LFE gain in the exported physical sub chain. This is
normally false because redirected bass and LFE share the same sub output.

enabled.description: Enable bass-management semantics for home-cinema workflows.

group_crossovers.description:
Optional role-group to crossover-key mapping. Supported built-in group
ids are `lcr`, `surround`, `height`, and `wide`; unknown ids are kept as
custom metadata groups.

headroom_margin_db.description: Headroom reserve expected downstream for bass-managed playback.

headroom_model.description: Programme-correlation model used for bass-bus headroom simulation.

lfe_low_pass_hz.description:
LFE programme-channel low-pass cutoff. This is independent of the
speaker crossover used to redirect bass from the main channels.

lfe_playback_gain_db.description:
Cinema LFE playback calibration gain. Reported in metadata; not applied
to the sub correction chain unless `apply_lfe_gain_to_chain` is set.

max_sub_boost_db.description: Maximum allowed positive sub boost from RoomEQ bass management.

optimize_groups.description: Optimize crossover settings independently per speaker group.

redirect_bass.description: Whether small-speaker bass is redirected to the subwoofer output.

sub_trim_db.description: User sub trim applied after crossover/alignment optimization.

selected_sub_low_pass_hz.description:
Per-sub selected low-pass frequencies in positional sub order
(entry `i` is the splice low-pass for sub `i`).

Empty unless the subwoofer crossover resolved to a per-sub list and
the per-sub splice stage ran. The shared-bus routing graph still
deploys `selected_crossover_hz` on every redirected-bass route; these
entries are the per-driver values for downstream per-driver export,
applied pre-sum when drivers share one bus.

source_results.description:
Per-logical-input route alignment. Crossover frequency and type remain
shared by the referenced speaker group.

input_trim_db.description: Final down-only calibration trims per logical input channel.

stereo_routing.description: Stereo-only topology diagnostics. Home cinema always leaves this unset.

BassManagementSourceReport.description:
Bass-management alignment for one logical input source.

Independent programme channels are intentionally not coherently summed
when these values are optimized. The source references a group for the
shared crossover type and frequency, but owns its route delay, polarity,
and trim.

safety_restored.description:
True when the candidate was accepted by restoring hard crossover
safety (baseline underfill excessive, candidate underfills fully
acceptable) despite a worse raw per-source objective. The raw
regression is the documented cost of the safety repair, not an
optimizer defect: QA gates exempt exactly this basis, nothing else.

selected_low_pass_hz.description:
Low-pass selected for this physical sub output by the per-sub splice
stage (`None` unless a per-sub crossover list was configured and the
shared-array splice search for this output ran). This filter owns the
redirected-bass cutoff, so those routes omit another group low-pass.
The LFE programme retains its independent low-pass.

BootstrapScalarisation.description: How to scalarise the per-bootstrap-resample losses into one outer-loop loss.

oneOf.description:
Pure worst-case: max loss across the B resamples. Most conservative; can be
driven by a single outlier resample.

Mean of the worst α-fraction of resamples (CVaR). Smoother, less sensitive
to a single freak resample than `WorstCase`.

BootstrapUncertaintyConfig.description:
Serializable spatial case-bootstrap configuration for JSON config files.
It estimates seat-sampling variability, not repeat-sweep or calibration uncertainty.

Drives `MultiMeasurementStrategy::MinimaxUncertainty`. At optimizer-setup
time, the input N measurement curves are case-bootstrap resampled B times;
each resampled mean becomes its own per-measurement objective. The outer
optimizer then scalarises the B objectives per `scalarisation`.

alpha.description: Two-sided confidence level α; band covers `[α/2, 1-α/2]`. Default: 0.10.

calibration_uncertainty_std_db.description: Separately supplied calibration uncertainty (dB standard deviation).

cvar_alpha.description: Tail fraction for CVaR (only used when `scalarisation = Cvar`). Default 0.20.

effective_spatial_sample_size.description:
Optional effective number of independent spatial positions.
Values below the nominal seat count widen the spatial bootstrap by
drawing fewer independent cases per resample.

num_resamples.description: Number of bootstrap resamples B. Typical: 200..1000. Default: 400.

repeat_sweep_noise_std_db.description: Separately measured repeat-sweep noise (dB standard deviation).

alpha.description: Two-sided alpha used for confidence bands.

assumes_independent_positions.description: Whether the estimator treats listening positions as independent cases.

calibration_uncertainty_std_db.description: Calibration uncertainty, absent unless separately supplied.

cvar_alpha.description: CVaR tail fraction when scalarisation is CVaR.

effective_spatial_sample_size.description:
Effective spatial sample size under the stated independence model.

This equals the nominal seat count by default. A configured correlation
adjustment may reduce it; this still is not a covariance/block model.

repeat_sweep_noise_std_db.description: Repeat-sweep noise, absent unless separately measured.

used_for_correction_depth_mask.description: Whether bootstrap confidence width was folded into correction-depth masks.

oneOf.description: Case-bootstrap over listening positions, not measurement noise.

BudgetAggregation.description: How per-condition differences aggregate against a cumulative cap.

Worst single-condition difference must stay under the cap.

Direct/early/late correction-energy metrics (optional, FIR/phase modes

Third-octave early/late energy from the channel's measured room IR,

ChannelEarlyLateCurves.description:
Third-octave early/late energy report for one channel's measured room IR.

The viewer renders this field only when `method`, `reference`,
`smoothing`, and `split_ms` carry the exact values below and the three
curves share one finite grid covering 1–8 kHz. Absence renders as
"pending", never as success.

direct_reference.description:
Direct-sound reference: `"broadband envelope peak"`, or
`"120 Hz lowpass envelope peak"` for subwoofer/LFE channels.

early.description: Band energy in the first 20 ms after the direct reference.

full.description: Incoherent sum of early and late band energies (not a complex sum).

late.description: Band energy after the first 20 ms until the IR ends.

split_ms.description: Early/late split after the direct reference, in milliseconds.

valid_band_hz.description: Third-octave coverage of the emitted curves in Hz.

ChannelEarlyReflections.description:
Band-limited early-reflection table for one channel's measured room IR.

The viewer renders this field only when `method`, `band_hz`,
`threshold_dbfs`, and a nonempty `direct_reference` carry the exact
values below. Absence renders as pending, never as success.

post.description: Post-correction events; empty until a post-correction IR is measured.

pre.description: Pre-correction events from the measured IR.

max_filters.description: Maximum number of additional PEQ filters per channel for matching

threshold_db.description: ICD RMS threshold in dB below which no correction is applied

ChannelOctaveT60.description:
Nine-band octave T60 report for one channel's measured room IR.

The viewer requires all nine ordered bands with valid rows carrying
`T20`/`T30` fits above `min_r2`, and invalid rows carrying a nonempty
reason with no plotted value. Absence renders as pending.

bands.description: Nine octave bands, 63 Hz–16 kHz in order.

ChannelOperationGate.description:
Operation-boundary verdicts for one channel on the public workflow path.

The workflow intake evaluates every applicable operation against the
channel's declared provenance and attaches one gate per channel to the
pipeline result. Consumers (phase dispatch, target policy, the final
ledger) read these records instead of re-deriving permissions from a
single phase flag.

measurement_id.description: Stable measurement identifier the verdicts apply to.

records.description: One record per evaluated operation and band, in evaluation order.

rew_header_facts.description:
Declared REW header facts transcribed from the source file.

Report-only provenance: verdicts never read these fields (a
declaration is not verification). `None` means the source carried
no transcribable header.

ChannelOperationalSummary.description:
Per-channel share of decided final equalization scope that was delivered.

Normative rule (req-roomeq-report R6), computed over the reconciled final
ledger only:
- scope: final-stage records (`is_final_claim`) with action `Equalize`,
  grouped by `physical_output`;
- a record superseded by another record in the same ledger (its
  `decision_id` appears in another record's `supersedes_ids`) is no longer
  operative and is excluded from both counts;
- delivered: scope records with status `Applied`, `AlreadyAcceptable`, or
  `Constrained` — the same delivery-claim set reconciliation binds to the
  delivered graph. `Reverted`, `InsufficientEvidence`, `OutsideScope`, and
  `Unresolved` scope lowers the share; `Advisory` records never enter it
  because provisional history cannot become a final claim;
- `operational_response_pct` is `100 * delivered / decided`. It is a
  ledger-delivery share with provenance-bound bands, not a measured
  band-compliance percentage: an empty decided scope yields no percentage.

decided_equalize.description: Decided final equalization records for the channel.

operational_response_pct.description:
Share of decided final equalization scope delivered, in percent.
`None` only when the scope count is zero; summaries are then omitted.

ChannelReflectionEvent.description:
One detected early reflection from a measured room IR.

Gains are dBFS relative to the 1–8 kHz filtered direct peak; times are
post-direct milliseconds. The viewer cross-checks distance against
34.3 cm/ms and the first dip against 500/time_ms, and requires gains in
`[-15, 0]` dBFS within 15 ms.

gain_dbfs.description: Event gain in dBFS relative to the filtered direct peak.

ripple_db.description: Comb ripple in dB; null when the gain equals direct (unbounded).

ChannelResonanceDecay.description: One prominent resonance decay slice from a measured room IR.

decay_time_s.description:
Fitted decay time in seconds; null when the bin has no fittable
20–200 ms decay.

level_db.description: Level at the 60 ms slice in dB relative to the waterfall grid peak.

ChannelResonanceDecays.description:
Prominent-resonance decay slices for one channel's measured room IR.

The viewer renders this field only when `basis`, `method`, and
`reference` carry the exact values below. An empty `decays` list means
the analysis ran and found no prominent resonances, not a failure.
Absence of the field renders as pending.

decays.description: Detected resonances with fitted decay times.

slice_ms.description: Slice offset after the direct peak in milliseconds; always `60`.

ChannelT60Band.description: One octave-band Schroeder/T60 fit from a measured room IR.

fit_range.description:
Fit range that produced the value (`T30`/`T20`; also `EDT` on rows
that stay invalid because EDT alone is not late-decay T60).

r2.description: `r²` of the selected fit (0.0 when invalid).

t60_s.description: Selected T60 in seconds; null when invalid.

valid.description: Whether the value passed the fit-range + `min_r2` policy.

ChannelWaterfall.description:
STFT waterfall decay grid for one channel's measured room IR (pre-
correction only; there is no post-correction IR at optimization time).

The viewer renders this field only when `basis`, `method`, and
`reference` carry the exact values below and the grid is a nonempty
finite `times × freqs` matrix matching `mags_db`. Absence renders as
pending, never as success.

mags_db.description: Magnitudes in dB relative to the grid peak, `mags_db[frame][bin]`.

reference.description:
Level reference; always `"full_grid_peak"` (each grid is relative
to its own peak, so two channels' grids do not compare absolutely).

times_ms.description: Frame centre times relative to the direct peak in milliseconds.

ChannelWavelet.description:
Three-cycle wavelet heatmap for one channel's measured room IR (pre-
correction only).

The viewer renders this field only when `basis`, `method`, and
`reference` carry the exact values below and the heatmap is a nonempty
finite `freqs × times` matrix matching `mags_db` with at least two
frequency rows and two time columns. Absence renders as pending.

freqs_per_octave.description: Log-grid density: `48` in dense measured exports, `6` in legacy reports.

hop_ms.description:
Minimum nominal hop in milliseconds; use `times_ms` for exact coordinates.
Dense exports sample at 0.1 ms through 15 ms and 1 ms thereafter.

mags_db.description: Magnitudes in dB relative to the grid peak, `mags_db[freq][time]`.

times_ms.description: Frame centre times relative to the direct peak in milliseconds.

CoherentTimingEvidence.description:
Whether evaluated inputs share one verified timing reference.

Phase arrays only prove values exist. Coherent summation additionally
needs every contributing capture to share one calibrated time zero.
Variants keep unknown inputs visibly limited instead of passing
finite-but-unsynchronized phase as verified evidence.

oneOf.description: Coherent timing was not assessed at this boundary.
Every evaluated input shares the cited reference across stationary captures.

reference_id.description: Shared timing-reference identity cited by all evaluated inputs.

oneOf.description: Verification failed; coherent claims stay unsupported.

ContinuousListeningAreaConfig.description:
Serializable continuous listening-area configuration for JSON config files.

Drives `MultiSeatStrategy::ContinuousArea`. The optimizer integrates the
per-position objective over a continuous prior π(p) defined over a
`dimensions`-dimensional axis-aligned box, replacing the discrete seats
array with a continuous probability density.

`bounds.len()` must equal `dimensions`. For Gaussian priors,
`mean.len()` and `cov_diag.len()` must also equal `dimensions`.
`seat_positions.len()` must equal the number of discrete seats in the
calibration `MultiSeatMeasurements` and each row's length must equal
`dimensions`.

# Seat-identity / ordering contract

`primary_seat` (on [`MultiSeatConfig`](super::multi_seat_config::MultiSeatConfig))
is a positional index while `seat_positions` is a parallel array: the
loader only checks equal counts, not semantic correspondence, so a swapped
order in one sub/source silently combines different physical positions.
Two mechanisms close this gap:

- **Stable seat IDs (recommended).** Set
  [`SeatIdentityMap`](super::multi_seat_config::SeatIdentityMap) on the
  sibling [`MultiSeatConfig`](super::multi_seat_config::MultiSeatConfig)
  to one unique, non-empty ID per seat. Consumers (`roomeq-workflow`,
  `roomeq-engine`) must join every source's per-seat measurements to
  these IDs via
  [`ContinuousListeningAreaConfig::check_source_seat_coverage`] instead of
  relying on index order, and must echo the IDs in output reports
  ([`ContinuousAreaMetrics`](crate::output::ContinuousAreaMetrics)) so the
  correspondence is auditable.
- **Strict positional ordering (legacy).** When no seat IDs are provided,
  `seat_positions[i]` corresponds to measurement seat index `i`, and every
  sub/source must present seats in exactly the same order. Any reordering
  on one source silently mixes positions; prefer stable IDs.

Per-axis bounding-box bounds `(lo, hi)`. Always required; even for
Gaussian priors the bounds determine the truncation rectangle.

Number of spatial dimensions (typical: 1 for a couch line, 2 for an
MLP rectangle, 3 for a head-volume sweep). Currently 1, 2, and 3 are
supported by the runtime dispatcher.

scalarisation.description: How to scalarise the Q per-point losses.

seat_positions.description:
Spatial coordinates of each calibration seat in
`MultiSeatMeasurements`. Outer length = number of seats, inner length =
`dimensions`. Order must match the seat index in the measurements
(see the strict-ordering contract above when no explicit seat IDs
are provided via
[`SeatIdentityMap`](super::multi_seat_config::SeatIdentityMap)).

Optional multi-position quality evidence. Runtime callers without

observations.description:
Non-violating limit assessments recorded for audit agreement.

Entries explain why an apparent limit/value divergence is not a
violation under the defined quantity semantics (for example, an

electrical bound stays within it). Observations never change the
outcome; only `violations` do.

The optimizer's observation/evaluation band remains unchanged. When the

source response is allowed to remain there instead of being flattened.

Permit measured response outside the correction support to remain

FilterAudibilityConfig.description:
Per-filter audibility veto for emitted PEQ filters (Phase A of the
audibility plan).

Every threshold here is an implementation-time starting calibration,
shipped first in report-only mode: with `report_only: true` (the default)
the veto evaluates every filter and records reason-coded verdicts but
never removes anything, so default behavior is unchanged. Enforcement
(`report_only: false` plus `allow_enforcement_with_experimental_proxy`)
is opt-in and experimental. `None` on the owning optimizer config
disables the veto entirely (no evaluation, no output change).

The veto prices each biquad in perceptual units on the ERB-rate axis
(see `roomeq_engine::eq::audibility_veto`): peak with/without level
difference, affected ERB width, and an approximate masked-loudness delta
at calibrated SPL. None of these is a reference-grade ISO 532
implementation; that arrives with the Phase D objective. Threshold
numerics must be re-verified against primary psychoacoustic publications
before any default flip.

allow_enforcement_with_experimental_prox.description:
Explicit acknowledgment that the loudness proxy is experimental and
unvalidated (see `roomeq_engine::eq::audibility_veto`). Enforcement
stays advisory until this is set to `true`: `report_only: false`
alone never removes filters.

elimination_loudness_delta_sones.description:
Backward-elimination threshold in approximate masked-loudness delta
(sones): filters whose removal changes total loudness by less than
this are eliminated. Provisional calibration; report-only first.

elimination_raw_loss_fallback.description:
Back-compat fallback: interpret `elimination_threshold` in raw loss
units as before instead of veto (loudness-delta) units.

enabled.description: Master switch for the veto evaluation. `false` skips evaluation.

hf_guard_enabled.description: Apply the narrow high-Q HF veto above the guard start.

hf_guard_max_q.description:
Filters centered above the guard start with Q above this are pruned
as narrow high-frequency corrections.

hf_guard_start_hz.description:
HF guard start in Hz. `None` reuses the active
`high_frequency_correction.start_hz` (or its default).

jnd_db.description:
ERB-mapped level-difference audibility floor in dB. Filters whose
peak with/without difference falls below this are inaudible ripple.

listening_level_phon.description:
Calibrated evaluation SPL in phons. `None` reuses the EPA
`listening_level_phon` (or its 75 default).

min_audible_erb_width.description:
Minimum affected ERB width for an audible filter. Corrections
narrower than this change too little loudness to matter.

mode_proximity_ban_erbs.description:
Half-width in ERBs of the Phase B mode-proximity boost ban.
Reserved: recorded but not enforced until Phase B wires the
minimum-phase/variance gate.

report_only.description:
Report-only mode: record verdicts but never remove filters.
Enforcement requires explicitly setting this to `false` *and*
acknowledging the experimental proxy (see below).

FilterVetoVerdict.description:
Reason-coded audibility verdict for one emitted biquad.

In report-only mode `decision` is still computed honestly, but the
caller must not remove the filter; `enforced: false` marks verdicts
that were recorded without effect.

acceptance.description:
Validated acceptance of the nomination (Stage 1 adjudication).
Default (unassessed) record when only nomination ran.

affected_erb_width.description: ERB-rate width of the affected region.

decision.description:
Keep/remove outcome of the veto rules.

This is the heuristic *nomination*, not an accepted removal: a
`Remove` here becomes `CandidateRemoval` until the Stage 1

enforced.description:
Whether a `Remove` verdict was actually enforced (false in

max_attenuation_db.description:
Maximum additional attenuation installed on non-subwoofer outputs, in dB.

max_useful_output_loss_db.description:
Maximum unexplained useful-output loss for mains, surrounds, and heights, in dB.
Subwoofers are exempt. This is not input attenuation or PEQ boost.

min_improvement_lower_bound_db.description:
Minimum uncertainty-adjusted improvement for a candidate to ship, in dB.

Every training seat's `improvement_lower_bound_db` (improvement after
subtracting summation uncertainty) must exceed this floor, or the
candidate is rejected as showing no demonstrated benefit and selection
falls back to a simpler protected result. Identity candidates (no
meaningful correction applied) skip the floor: with nothing applied
there is nothing to reject, and they flow through as the protected
baseline. The default 0.0 is the measurement-uncertainty boundary,
not a perceptual threshold: raising it needs repeat-capture and
listening evidence (WP7), never a guess.

MultiSeatSearchConfig.description:
Stage-specific search contract for multi-seat optimization.

`MultiSeatConfig` exposes the polarity/all-pass toggles and the
continuous-area prior but historically carried no outer evaluation/time
budget or seed: the engine used fixed internal values. This block lets
callers pin those down per run. Every field is optional or capped with a
default that preserves the historical behavior:

- `seed`, `evaluation_budget`, `time_budget_ms` are `None` by default,
  meaning "engine legacy behavior" (fixed internal seed/budgets).
  Consumers (`roomeq-workflow`, `roomeq-engine`) must treat an explicit
  value as authoritative and `None` as "keep doing what you do today".
- The `max_*` caps bound resource use. Validation rejects quadrature and
  all-pass configurations above the effective caps; the defaults are
  generous so previously valid configs keep passing.

evaluation_budget.description:
Outer evaluation budget (objective evaluations). `None` = engine
legacy budget.

max_allpass_per_sub.description:
Maximum per-sub all-pass filters (`allpass_filters_per_sub` must not
exceed this).

max_quadrature_points.description:
Maximum Sobol / Latin-hypercube quadrature points, and maximum total
Gauss-Legendre points (`points_per_axis^dimensions`).

seed.description:
PRNG seed for the multi-seat search (quadrature sampling, stochastic
stages). `None` = engine legacy fixed seed.

time_budget_ms.description:
Wall-clock budget in milliseconds. `None` = no model-level limit
(engine legacy behavior).

oneOf.description: Minimize standard deviation across all seats (default)
Optimize for primary seat with constraints on others
Optimize for average response across all seats
Complex modal-basis sound-field management across seats

Continuous listening-area prior: integrate the variance / mean / worst-case
objective over a probability density over positions, instead of the
discrete seat slots. Requires `MultiSeatConfig::continuous_area` to be set.

Enable per-subwoofer all-pass filter optimization.

joint_optimization.description:
Select joint coherent multi-sub optimization over the
source-by-seat transfer matrix instead of the variation-only
detailed mode. Requires per-seat measurements with phase on
every sub and a verified shared timing reference. Refuses missing
evidence without running an alternate optimizer. Takes precedence over legacy
`optimizer.multi_seat` processing for this group. Default: false.
Routed systems must select subwoofer strategy `mso`; `single` would
select independent subs and is rejected when joint mode is requested.

role/crossover-aware evaluation window so that routes do not penalize
intentional crossover rolloff. Runs with different `loss_type` values
stay on the same scale within that channel role. To compare *perceptual* outcomes across
loss types use `epa_per_channel.{pre,post}.preference` instead,
which is computed identically for every run.

loss_type.description:
Loss function type. Supported values:
- `"flat"` — minimize deviation from target (default)
- `"score"` — maximize Harman/Olive preference score
- `"epa"` — EPA (Evaluation/Potency/Activity) psychoacoustic

  and loudness-balance penalties derived from Zwicker metrics.
  When selected, the EPA penalty weights can be customized via
  the [`epa_config`](Self::epa_config) field; otherwise the
  defaults from [`EpaConfig::default`](crate::loss::epa::score::EpaConfig::default)
  are used.

worst_seat.description: Lowest-benefit training seat as `input:index`, when evaluated.

Backend-neutral serialized plugin descriptor. Native adapters translate this
contract into their runtime types; the model does not depend on AudioEngine.

threshold_db.description:
Maximum pre-ringing level in dB relative to main tap. Default: -30.0

Design-time per-channel threshold: it constrains FIR design, not the
reported cross-channel aggregate. Runtime acceptance compares the
aggregate masking-derived audible value against its own −20 dB
ceiling, so an aggregate between the two is expected, not a
demonstrated design violation.

high_hz.description: Upper edge of the band in Hz (inclusive).

limit_db.description: Maximum lagging-source level above the primary in this band, in dB.

house_curve.description: Optional house curve extracted from the neutral optimizer target.

ProbeResultsLegacy.description:
Serializable mirror of the engine's `ProbeDelayResults`. Kept
in-crate (rather than depending on `sotf-engine` or `sotf-player`)
so the autoeq crate remains lean. Fields match the engine type
1:1 so round-trip through serde is lossless.

ProcessingMode.description: Processing mode for the optimization engine

oneOf.description: Low-latency mode (IIR filters only) - < 5ms latency
Phase-linear mode (FIR filters only) - High latency allowed
Hybrid mode (IIR for bass, FIR for mids/highs) - Variable latency

Mixed-phase mode (IIR for minimum-phase + excess phase FIR)
Requires phase data in measurements. Low latency (~10ms).

Warped IIR mode — exports RoomEQ filters as warped biquads using a
Bark-scale lambda. The optimizer currently uses the same biquad
placement/scoring path as low_latency, then serializes the runtime
topology as `warped_biquad`.

Kautz modal mode — pole-tuned filter targeting detected room modes.
Uses room mode analysis to place filter poles at resonance frequencies.
Gain optimization via linear least-squares (very fast, no DE needed).
Exports the runtime topology as `kautz_filter` with modal sections.
Best for small, highly resonant rooms with clear modal problems.
Returns an error if no room modes are detected.

ProvenanceCaptureKind.description:
Declared acquisition kind of one measurement source.

This is a declaration, not an inference: the loader never guesses a kind
from data shape. Undeclared sources stay [`ProvenanceCaptureKind::Unknown`]
and unknown never authorizes phase-critical work.

oneOf.description: Stationary impulse-response capture with a timing reference.

Spatial magnitude capture (including moving-microphone averages)
without a timing reference.
Direct-sound capture.
Exported-backend simulation or rendering; not an acoustic recording.
Capture kind not stated.

ProvenanceConfig.description: RoomEQ provenance references keyed by the configured speaker measurement.

ProvenanceValidationMode.description: How a RoomEQ request treats missing or inconsistent measurement evidence.

PruningBudget.description:
Cumulative pruning budget over declared conditions.

Experimental veto adjudication compares every accepted removal set with
frozen F0. Per-condition differences use the configured sum or maximum;
missing declared evidence retains filters rather than silently falling back.
Native EQ workflows resolve measured conditions through `evaluation`.
Without that declaration, adapters resolve only `flat-background`.

Differences remain approximate masked-loudness deltas in experimental proxy
units. These limits do not establish calibrated perceptual equivalence.

aggregation.description: How per-condition differences aggregate against the cap.

conditions.description:
Declared condition ids the budget spans (seats, programmes,
levels). Empty uses the complete evaluation product when supplied, otherwise
the legacy flat-background scope. A nonempty
declaration requires matching evidence for every identifier.

evaluation.description:
Optional versioned programme/level declaration over all supplied measurements.

When present, empty `conditions` means the complete generated condition
set; a nonempty list must match that set exactly. Missing native evidence
retains filters. `None` preserves the legacy flat-background scope.

max_cumulative_delta.description:
Cumulative cap in approximate masked-loudness delta (sones,
experimental proxy units). `None` uses the veto's per-step quantum as
the cumulative cap.

PruningEvaluation.description:
Complete experimental pruning condition declaration for one EQ measurement set.

All measurements are crossed with all programmes and levels. Identifiers
follow `<measurement>/<programme>/<level>phon`, for example
`seat-a/music/75phon`. A consumer must retain filters if it cannot supply
every measurement or support the declared comparison domain.

listening_levels_phon.description:
Positive finite nominal full-chain levels, evaluated separately per condition.

These are experimental proxy assumptions, not measured playback SPL.

measurement_ids.description:
Stable identifiers in the same order as the supplied measurements.

The number must match the complete measurement set, including measurements
that an optimizer averages or assigns zero weight. Never silently truncate.

programmes.description: Programme spectra applied independently to each measured response.

version.description: Required version pin; unknown versions are rejected during deserialization.

PruningEvaluationVersion.description: Version of the experimental condition interpretation.

oneOf.description: Magnitude spectra with each condition anchored to its frozen full chain.

PruningProgramme.description: Programme magnitude spectrum used by the experimental pruning proxy.

frequencies_hz.description: Strictly increasing positive frequencies covering the evaluation grid.

id.description: Stable, nonempty, slash-free identifier; not a file path.

spectrum_db.description:
Finite relative dB magnitudes, one per frequency.

This spectrum does not encode temporal masking or prove programme-audio
equivalence. No SPL calibration is implied by its offset.

PsychoacousticSmoothingConfig.description:
Psychoacoustic variable smoothing configuration

Different frequency ranges benefit from different smoothing levels:
- Low frequencies (< 100 Hz): Fine resolution (1/48 octave) to preserve room modes
- High frequencies (> 1 kHz): Coarse resolution (1/6 octave) to ignore comb filtering
- Transition region (100 Hz - 1 kHz): Gradual interpolation between the two

high_freq.description: Upper transition frequency in Hz (default: 1000 Hz)

high_freq_n.description: Smoothing resolution above high_freq (bands per octave, e.g., 6 for 1/6 octave)

low_freq.description: Lower transition frequency in Hz (default: 100 Hz)

low_freq_n.description: Smoothing resolution below low_freq (bands per octave, e.g., 48 for 1/48 octave)

QaSeedOutcome.description: Durable outcome of one QA seed, including rejected and reverted attempts.

accepted_useful.description: Explicit acceptance plus a material improvement of the delivered score.

safe_output.description:
Finite output with explicit final acceptance and no Failed stage.
False includes unverified/reverted output, not only proven unsafe DSP.
This does not imply useful EQ or independent backend certification.

bass_pre_modal_roughness_db_per_octave2.description:
Median RMS curvature of the residual below Schroeder frequency.

This is measured in dB/octave² and distinguishes a response with
narrow modal ripple from one with the same band RMS but a smooth tilt.

upper_pre_weighted_rms_db.description:
Median band RMS of the pre-correction residual above Schroeder frequency.

Paired with `upper_post_weighted_rms_db`, this lets the quality gate
enforce "do no harm" on timbre while the modal band is corrected.

worst_position_improvement_db.description: Smallest per-position improvement. Negative values are regressions.

QuasiAnechoicPolicy.description: Explicit assessment budgets, not universal acoustic thresholds.

cycles_for_valid_band.description: Full cycles required within the reflection-free gate.

min_off_axis_abs_deg.description: Minimum absolute angle counting as off-axis, in degrees.

min_off_axis_count.description: Minimum number of distinct off-axis directions.

RealizedProcessing.description:
Correction family actually present in the shipped graph.

Derived from serialized channel and per-driver plugins, never from the
requested mode label: a mixed-phase run whose excess-phase FIR never
materialized reports [`RealizedProcessing::IirOnly`], and a fully
reverted run reports [`RealizedProcessing::Identity`]. `eq`,
`warped_biquad`, and `kautz_filter` vote IIR; `convolution` votes FIR.
Gain, delay, and crossover plugins are alignment/routing: a graph with
only those reports [`RealizedProcessing::AlignmentOnly`], which still
corrects level and timing (audible in joint summation) but shapes no
frequency response.

oneOf.description: No correction or alignment plugin on any channel or driver.

Only gain/delay/crossover plugins: level and timing alignment
without frequency-response shaping.
IIR correction plugins but no `convolution` anywhere.
`convolution` plugins but no IIR correction anywhere.

Both IIR correction and `convolution` present (band-split FIR or
excess-phase correction).

RecordingConfiguration.description:
Recording configuration stored with measurements
Contains device settings and signal parameters used during measurement capture

bass_anchor_results.description:
Bass anchor results captured during the GD-1e BassAnchor
wizard step — per-channel phase of a low-frequency tone burst
at `bass_probe_freq_hz`. Populated after the wizard finishes;
absent when the user skipped the step.

bass_anchor_wav_relative.description:
Relative path (within the recording directory) of the raw
bass-anchor WAV. `None` when the BassAnchor step was skipped
or when recording persistence was disabled.

bass_octave_duration_s.description:
Per-octave bass sweep duration in seconds. Defaults to 3.0; the
sweep generator scales total duration so that the band below
100 Hz receives `bass_octave_duration_s` seconds per octave.
Clamped to `[1.0 .. 10.0]` at load time.

bass_probe_duration_s.description:
Total length of the steady-state bass-anchor tone in seconds
(steady portion + fades). Default 2.0.

The pre-v2 schema stored `bass_probe_cycles: u16` here — it's
dropped silently at load (the units differ and converting
requires `bass_probe_freq_hz` which serde sees per-field). The
per-result `BassAnchorResultsLegacy::bass_duration_s` migration
handles legacy run-output files (where the conversion is well
defined).

bass_probe_freq_hz.description:
Centre frequency of the bass tone burst captured by the
BassAnchor wizard step. Default 20.0 Hz (or
`1.25 * min_freq`, whichever is higher).

capture_handoff_file.description:
Required acquisition inventory for newly exported capture configurations.
The canonical filename is `capture-handoff.json`; missing or changed
inventories are refused before correction. Absent on legacy imports.

channel_speakers.description:
Per-channel speaker identity (brand + model) as free-form
strings, ideally autocompleted from the spinorama.org catalog.
Keyed by channel name so it round-trips through reorder/rename.
Not consumed by the optimizer — metadata only.

coherence_threshold.description:
Coherence threshold below which the GD confidence gate declares
bass phase untrustworthy. Default 0.9. Clamped to `[0.5 .. 0.99]`.

mic_phase_calibration_path.description:
Path to the microphone phase calibration CSV (4 columns:
`freq, mag_db, phase_deg, coherence`). Magnitude calibration
already lives under [`mic_calibration_path`](Self::mic_calibration_path).

mic_phase_calibration_paths.description:
Per-channel mic phase calibration files, aligned with
[`mic_calibration_paths`](Self::mic_calibration_paths).

num_positions.description:
Number of measurement positions (seats) the user captured. `None`
or `Some(1)` means a single-position session; `Some(n)` with
`n >= 2` means each `ChannelMeasurement.multi_mic_measurements`
holds `n * num_mics - 1` entries in `(position, mic)` order
(primary measurement is `(0, 0)`).

num_sweeps.description:
Number of sweeps recorded back-to-back for coherence averaging.
Default 4. Clamped to `[1 .. 8]` at load time.

post_silence_s.description:
Post-sweep silence window in seconds. Default
`schroeder_rt60 + 1.0`; falls back to `2.0` if no RT60 estimate
is available.

pre_silence_s.description:
Pre-sweep silence window in seconds. Used by the coherence
averager to estimate the noise-floor. Default 2.0.

probe_results.description:
Tone-burst delay probe results captured during the Recording
wizard's Probe step. Stored here so the `autoeq::roomeq`
pipeline can pick them up at config-load time without requiring
a live measurement. Mirrors the shape of the engine's
`ProbeDelayResults` for cross-crate serde compatibility.

probe_wav_relative.description:
Relative path (within the recording directory) of the raw
probe WAV persisted by `probe_channel_delays_with_recording`.
`None` for sessions that skipped the Probe step.

room_dimensions.description:
Physical room dimensions (metric — length/width/height in meters)
collected from the user at save time. When present these are
reused by the optimizer's Schroeder-frequency auto-detection; see
[`RoomDimensions::schroeder_frequency_with_rt60`].

setup_description.description:
Free-form description of the listening setup (treatment,
seating, notes about speaker placement, etc.). Not consumed by
the optimizer — stored purely for session reproducibility.

signal_type.description: Signal type used for measurements (e.g. "Sweep", "Pink Noise")

spl_calibration.description:
SPL calibration anchor captured from a pre-sweep reference tone.
Required on new recordings by the SplCalibration wizard step;
stored here so that replayed recordings can re-derive
`sweep_level_db_spl`.

sweep_end_freq.description: Sweep end frequency in Hz (only applicable when signal_type is "Sweep")

sweep_level_db_spl.description:
Target sweep level at the listening position in dBSPL. Requires
[`spl_calibration`](Self::spl_calibration) to be populated.

sweep_start_freq.description: Sweep start frequency in Hz (only applicable when signal_type is "Sweep")

ReportOutcome.description:
Outcome of assessing one proposed simplification or correction.

These are the only report outcomes a later stage may emit: assessment
code maps its internal verdicts onto this vocabulary instead of
inventing per-stage reason strings.

oneOf.description: The full-chain comparison supports keeping the current processing.

A simplification is nominated but not yet accepted: it needs the
cumulative check against the frozen full chain before anything
is applied.

A nominated simplification passed its acceptance checks and was
applied. Compare against the frozen full chain, not the
pre-removal step.

Correction proceeds under explicit limits (gain caps, band
restrictions, seat subsets) because evidence is partial.
Records the limits, not just the decision.

Evidence is missing or too weak to decide. Uncertain cases retain
the filter; "unknown" is never evidence of safety or inaudibility.

ReportingConfig.description:
Report-policy inputs that need an explicit operator declaration.

These change no acceptance math: they declare the policy the viewer uses
to render summary cells from emitted evidence. Absent stays pending.

t60_flatness_tolerance_s.description:
Declared ±tolerance in seconds for the report Section 1 T60 flatness
share (nine measured octave fits within tolerance of the
complete-channel room mean). When `None`, the viewer applies the
ITU-R BS.1116-2 §8.2.3.1 Fig. 1 midband default of ±0.05 s and labels
the cell accordingly. A present value must be finite and positive.

RirPrototypeConfig.description: Configuration for building a distance- and directivity-weighted RIR prototype.

distance_mode.description: How distance translates into a weight.

frequency_dependent_directivity.description: If true, apply directivity per frequency bin; otherwise use a broadband factor at 1 kHz.

microphone_positions.description: Position of each microphone, in the same order as the measurements.

reference_position.description: Optimal listening position (e.g., center of the head at the main seat).

source_position.description: Position of the main loudspeaker that defines the forward/directivity axis.

RoleTargetConfig.description:
Optional role-aware target adjustments for home-cinema layouts.

These are deliberately explicit and default to zero change: enabling the
block makes the target semantics role-aware without silently changing
existing RoomEQ output. The adjustments layer on top of
[`TargetResponseConfig::preference`].

center_dialog_boost_db.description: Broad, smooth center-channel dialog-band target lift/cut in dB.

center_dialog_high_hz.description: Upper edge of the center dialog emphasis band.

center_dialog_low_hz.description: Lower edge of the center dialog emphasis band.

center_slope_offset_db_per_octave.description: Extra broadband slope for the center channel, in dB/octave.

center_treble_shelf_db.description: Additional treble shelf applied only to the centre channel.

cinema_reference_distance_m.description: Reference distance for distance-compensated treble rolloff.

cinema_x_curve_db_per_octave.description: Additional high-frequency slope above `cinema_x_curve_start_hz`, in dB/octave.

cinema_x_curve_enabled.description: Enable cinema/X-curve style high-frequency rolloff shaping.

cinema_x_curve_start_hz.description: Frequency where cinema/X-curve high-frequency shaping starts.

distance_treble_rolloff_db_per_doubling.description: Additional HF rolloff per distance doubling beyond the reference distance.

front_slope_offset_db_per_octave.description: Extra broadband slope for front L/R channels, in dB/octave.

height_slope_offset_db_per_octave.description: Extra broadband slope for height channels, in dB/octave.

height_treble_shelf_db.description: Additional treble shelf applied to height channels.

lfe_bass_shelf_db.description: Additional bass shelf applied to LFE channels.

lfe_slope_offset_db_per_octave.description: Extra broadband slope for LFE channels, in dB/octave.

listening_distance_m.description: Listening distance used for optional distance-compensated treble rolloff.

subwoofer_bass_shelf_db.description: Additional bass shelf applied to subwoofer channels.

subwoofer_slope_offset_db_per_octave.description: Extra broadband slope for subwoofer channels, in dB/octave.

surround_slope_offset_db_per_octave.description: Extra broadband slope for surround and wide channels, in dB/octave.

surround_treble_shelf_db.description: Additional treble shelf applied to side/rear/wide surrounds.

crossovers.description: Optional crossover configuration for multi-driver groups

measured_impulse_responses.description:
Measured room impulse responses per channel, backing the R1–R5
acoustic report fields. Keys are output channel names; values are
`time_ms,amplitude` CSVs captured in the room. Channels without an
entry keep synthesized IRs and their report cells stay pending.

provenance.description: Versioned measurement-sidecar references and validation policy.

recording_config.description: Recording configuration (device settings, signal parameters used during capture)

reporting.description:
Report-policy inputs needing an explicit operator declaration (for
example the T60 flatness tolerance). Absent policies leave the viewer
to its documented standard defaults; they change no acceptance math.

speakers.description: Map of channel name to speaker configuration

system.description: System configuration (v3) separating logical inputs from physical outputs.

version.description:
Configuration schema version. Version 3.0.x intentionally rejects the
legacy stereo-LFE representation.

RoomDimensions.description: Room dimensions for automatic Schroeder frequency calculation

RoomEqOutcome.description:
User-facing outcome of comparing a realized correction with its frozen
original baseline. This is deliberately separate from the implementation
decision so an identity fallback can be reported as unchanged and a
phase/seat evidence gap can be reported as insufficient evidence.

RoomOptimizerEvidence.description:
Versioned optimizer-confidence evidence used by final production
acceptance. Superseded attempts remain visible in `runs_by_channel`, while
`confidence` is derived only from runs marked `selected_for_output`.

RuntimeAcceptancePolicy.description:
Versioned limits applied to production RoomEQ output.

The output class changes only temporal limits. Spectral, spatial, boost,
headroom, and realization limits are invariant across filter classes.

max_boost_db.description:
Ceiling for the gain backstop in dB.

Compares against the electrical filter-gain bound
(`max_electrical_boost_db`), not the acoustic response ratio:
improved interference near a baseline null can legitimately move
the ratio without any filter boosting. The acoustic
`max_boost_db` stays reported alongside; an acoustic-only excess
is recorded as an observation, while an unevaluable electrical
bound fails closed to a violation.

max_pre_ringing_audible_db.description:
Runtime ceiling for the aggregate masking-derived audible
pre-ringing (`TemporalQualityEvidence.pre_ringing_audible_db`).
Distinct from the −30 dB per-channel FIR design threshold, which
applies at design time, not to this aggregate.

SeatIdentityMap.description:
Stable seat identifiers closing the index/parallel-array correspondence gap.

`primary_seat` is a positional index while seat positions form a parallel
array: loaders only check equal counts, not semantic correspondence, so a
swapped order on one sub/source silently combines different physical
positions. One unique, non-empty ID per seat lets consumers
(`roomeq-workflow`, `roomeq-engine`) join every source's per-seat
measurements to IDs instead of relying on index order, and echo the IDs in
output reports so the correspondence is auditable.

ids.description:
One ID per seat, parallel to the seat order. Length must equal the
seat count; every entry must be non-empty and unique.

SmoothnessPenaltyConfigSerde.description: Serializable smoothness-penalty configuration for JSON config files.

exponent.description: L_p exponent. 1.0 = TV^2-like sparse curvature, 2.0 = L2 smoothing.

schroeder_hz.description: Optional Schroeder cutoff in Hz for reduced modal-region penalty.

tv2_weight.description: Penalty weight in loss units per (dB/decade^2)^exponent.

SpatialRobustnessSerdeConfig.description: Serializable spatial robustness configuration for JSON config files

mask_smoothing_octaves.description: Smoothing width in octaves for the correction depth mask. Default: 1/6 octave.

transition_width_db.description: Transition width (dB) for sigmoid blending. Default: 2.0

variance_threshold_db.description:
Threshold (dB) below which full correction is allowed. Despite the field
name, this is compared against the per-frequency *standard deviation*
across positions, not the variance. Default: 3.0

anyOf.description: Supporting-source room compensation (primary + delayed support loudspeaker).

SpeakerConfig.description:
Speaker configuration (can be single measurement or group)

Variant order matters for serde untagged deserialization: serde tries each variant
in order. `SupportingSource` is first because it requires the unique `primary` and
`support` fields. Topology is before legacy Group because its unique `drivers`
field selects the explicit representation. Named group variants are tried before
`Single`, which remains the catch-all.

SpeakerDriver.description: One separately measured driver in an explicit speaker topology.

crossover_band.description: Optional explicit linearization band. Crossover-derived defaults are used when absent.

id.description: Stable identifier used by output DSP chains and parallel-group membership.

SpeakerDriverRole.description: Declared acoustic role of a measured driver.

SpeakerGroup.description: Group of measurements for a single speaker (multi-driver)

drivers.description:
Drivers in low-to-high acoustic-band order. Members of a parallel group
may appear next to each other in any order within their shared band.

SplCalibration.description:
SPL calibration anchor captured from a pre-sweep reference tone.

Maps the peak sample value observed on the recording ADC during a
reference tone to a dBSPL reading taken by the user at the listening
position with an external meter. Once captured, the sweep playback
level is chosen so the in-band energy at the listening position hits
[`RecordingConfiguration::sweep_level_db_spl`](RecordingConfiguration::sweep_level_db_spl)
deterministically — avoiding the subwoofer driver over-excursion
that would otherwise contaminate bass phase with harmonic distortion.

peak_sample_level.description:
Peak sample value observed on the recording ADC during the tone,
in the range `[0.0 .. 1.0]`.

reference_freq_hz.description: Frequency of the calibration tone in Hz (default 1000).

reported_db_spl.description: User-reported dBSPL at the listening position during calibration.

spl_offset_db.description:
Offset mapping ADC peak level to dBSPL at the mic:
`dbspl_at_mic = 20 * log10(peak_sample_value) + spl_offset_db`.

checks.description: Assertions evaluated at this stage boundary.

num_filters.description: Number of PEQ filters for subwoofer channels

id.description: Stable physical output identifier used by routing and exporters.

speaker.description: Key of the measurement in the top-level `speakers` map.

Single subwoofer optimization (default)
Multi-Sub Optimizer (minimize seat-to-seat variance)
Double Bass Array (active cancellation)

max_sum_omitted_amplitude_ratio.description: Worst ratio of all omitted amplitude bounds to the retained complex sum.

SupportingSourceConfig.description: Configuration for a single supporting-source loudspeaker channel.

Unfiltered support arrival minus primary arrival at the reference seat,
measured in milliseconds using a common acquisition time reference.
Electrical delay is `delay_ms - acoustic_arrival_offset_ms`.

allow_unverified_acoustics.description:
Explicit experimental opt-in when arrival or coherent-sum evidence is
unavailable. Power-average design is not a coherent or perceptual guarantee.

decorrelation.description: Decorrelator applied to the supporting source path.

delay_ms.description: Delay of the supporting source relative to the primary at the listening position.

max_coherent_cancellation_db.description:
Engineering budget for a coherent dip below the louder branch, not an
audibility threshold.

precedence_limits.description: Frequency-dependent precedence limits. The first matching band wins.

shared_phase_reference.description: Both transfer-function phases retain the same acquisition time reference.

target_response.description: Target response to match. Defaults to the room-level `target_curve`.

velvet_noise_taps.description: Velvet-noise sequence length when decorrelation is enabled.

SupportingSourceDecorrelation.description: Decorrelation strategy for the supporting source path.

oneOf.description: Apply a velvet-noise sequence to the supporting source.
No decorrelation.

SupportingSourceGroup.description:
A speaker group representing a primary loudspeaker plus a delayed,
decorrelated supporting loudspeaker for room compensation.

This variant is distinguished from other `SpeakerConfig` variants by the
presence of the `primary` and `support` fields.

name.description: Human-readable name for this primary/support pair.

primary.description: Measurement source for the primary loudspeaker.

support.description: Measurement source for the supporting loudspeaker.

SupportingSourceOutputNaming.description: Naming convention for supporting-source physical outputs.

Suffix appended to the logical role for the supporting output.

advisories.description: Optional advisories raised during processing (e.g. spatial robustness).

delay_ms.description: Delay applied to the supporting source in ms.

drr_after_db.description:
DRR after compensation (dB) summary, available only with time-gated
impulse-response evidence.

drr_before_db.description:
DRR before compensation (dB) summary, available only with time-gated
impulse-response evidence.

precedence_limit_hits.description: Number of frequency bins where the precedence ceiling was hit.

primary_output.description: Name of the primary output channel.

propagation_relative_arrival_ms.description:

Post-masking window after the main impulse. Ringing grows more audible
as it decays beyond this window.

Pre-masking window before the main impulse. Pre-ringing inside this
window is partially masked; earlier energy is fully audible.

because pre-echo before a transient is especially objectionable.

alignment_delay_ms.description:

compilation (`delay_compile_causal`), in ms. Zero when compilation
was a no-op; absent when the compile boundary never stamped.

coherent_timing.description:
Shared-timing verification across evaluated inputs.
Unassessed where replay did not evaluate; replay upgrades the verdict.

latency_ms.description:
FIR design delay: the maximum main-impulse time across channels.

Kept under its legacy name; WP6 splits the playback total below.
`None` means unresolved FIR evidence, never zero latency.

phase_evidence_available.description:
True only when both pre and post responses carried measured phase.
A missing phase is an evidence limitation, never a zero-phase claim.
Presence alone never verifies coherent timing; see `coherent_timing`.

pre_ringing_audible_db.description:
Worst masking-derived audible pre-ringing across channels, in dB
relative to each FIR's main impulse peak.

This is the maximum of the per-channel `pre_ringing_audible_db`
values, not a physical pre/main energy ratio (that quantity is
`TemporalIrMaskingMetrics.pre_energy_ratio_db`). Runtime acceptance compares it
against `RuntimeAcceptancePolicy.max_pre_ringing_audible_db`
(−20 dB), which is distinct from the −30 dB per-channel FIR design
threshold: an aggregate between the two is expected, not a
demonstrated violation. Neither value proves audibility without
calibrated stimulus and listener context. IIR-only chains report
the `NO_FIR_PRE_RINGING_FLOOR_DB` sentinel (−300 dB), a
report floor rather than a measured room-noise floor.

temporal_evidence_available.description:
True when temporal measurements required by the output class exist.
For an IIR-only chain this is true because no FIR precursor claim is
being made; FIR and hybrid paths must provide measured masking data.

total_latency_ms.description:
Total modeled playback latency (design + alignment) in ms.

Excludes host/block buffering and converter delay, which the engine
cannot observe; the host adds those. Absent unless both summands
are assessed.

TiltStageConfig.description:
Appends an optimizer-driven LS plus HS tilt pair at the DSP chain end.

The pair extends `num_filters` by two instead of replacing peak slots, so
enabling tilt never moves the main filters' bounds. Both shelves use the
existing shelf limits (+/-`max_db` gain, pinned Q) and flow through the
same HF guard, audibility veto, and headroom stages as every other filter.

hs_band_hz.description:
HS hinge band `[lo, hi]` in Hz (`None` selects the upper geometric
half of the correction band).

ls_band_hz.description:
LS hinge band `[lo, hi]` in Hz (`None` selects the lower geometric
half of the correction band).

UpperBandAcousticBound.description:
Calibrated upper bound on an unmeasured acoustic transfer, before DSP.
An explicit declaration is a flat cap, not a fitted extrapolation. The
subwoofer stopband inference may instead record a measured rolloff, in
which case `max_spl_db` is the bound level at `band_hz[0]` and the bound
declines at `rolloff_db_per_oct` above it.

band_hz.description: Bound must overlap the measurement endpoint and cover the assessed band.

evidence_id.description: Stable reference to the calibration, specification, or measurement proof.

max_spl_db.description:
Same input reference and SPL calibration as the corresponding capture.
Flat cap everywhere when `rolloff_db_per_oct` is absent, level at
`band_hz[0]` when a rolloff is present.

partition.description: `training` or `held_out`, matching the immutable capture partition.

bass_evaluated_band_hz.description: Separate bass assessment so a broad main band cannot dilute lost bass.

extension_band_hz.description:
Lowest reliable octave of the evaluated band, when at least two
samples cover it. WP4 output distinction: loss here is lost low-end
extension, while `worst_unexplained_loss_db`/`loss_bands` describe
(usually narrow, benign) peak attenuation elsewhere.

extension_loss_db.description:
Log-frequency-weighted mean unexplained loss over
`extension_band_hz`. Stays near zero when cuts are peak-only.

logical_input.description: Present when evaluated by logical-input final playback replay.

loss_band_threshold_db.description: Diagnostic threshold only; aggregate runtime policy remains separate.

peak_demand_change_db.description:
Peak absolute demand shift: peak post level minus peak pre level
over the evaluated band. The acoustic drive proxy: how much less
(or more) peak output the system is asked to produce. Electrical
required-vs-available headroom stays in the bus simulation.

permitted_gain_db.description: Authorized broadband change, independent of fitted shape normalization.

target_shortfall_rms_db.description: Calibrated target deficit, without fitting away broadband level.

unexplained_loss_rms_db.description: Log-frequency-weighted RMS of losses beyond the authorized gain.
